description: This file provides utility functions for set operations on string slices, including difference, union, subtraction, filtering out unicode characters, and internal set management. It also defines a simpleSet type for internal use within the package.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a string exists and is enabled in the set.

methods.name: DistinctValues
methods.description: Returns strings unique to each of the two input slices, performing set difference and returning sorted result.

methods.name: SetSubtract
methods.description: Subtracts elements of one slice from another, returning elements present in the first but not in the second.

methods.name: SetUnion
methods.description: Returns the union of two string slices, sorted.

methods.name: sliceToSimpleSet
methods.description: Converts a slice of strings into a simpleSet.

methods.name: discardKeysFromOther
methods.description: Removes (sets to false) keys in the second set that are present in the first set.

methods.name: allKeys
methods.description: Returns all keys from multiple simpleSets, including duplicates.

methods.name: FilterNoUnicode
methods.description: Removes non-ASCII characters from the string.
